notes: Aggregates current Form 1099-R box-4 federal-withholding findings into the family subtotal, one of the four document subtotals Form 1040 line 25b adds (i1040gi-2025 l.2559-2567: 'Include on line 25b any federal income tax withheld on your Form(s) 1099-R ... The amount withheld should be shown in box 4'). Box 4 shares its payer/statement/tax-year identity with box 1 on the existing bounded IRA-fully-taxable statement, but is aggregated through its own independent family and closure (tax.us.2025.f1099r.box4) -- the engine enforces one authorized subtotal per family (ADR-0016), so box 4 cannot ride the box-1 family's own closure authority even though it shares that identity. Closed-empty publishes zero only through this family's own current literal-true closure. Published as its own rule so the explanation walk reaches this document (Track 1 contract item 2).
